Name: Manual_TheVault_Chakraa
description:
Manual games allow you to set custom check locations and custom item names that will be rolled into a multiworld.
This allows any variety of game -- PC, console, board games, Microsoft Word memes... really anything -- to be part of a multiworld randomizer.
The key component to including these games is some level of manual restriction. Since the items are not actually withheld from the player,
the player must manually refrain from using these gathered items until the tracker shows that they have been acquired or sent.

1.0.description:
- Initial Release with the full game
- Choose up to 100 Keys and Items within The Vault
- Crack it open for all the items inside!
- Use the help of your Goblin friends to accelerate the process!
- Be sure to use this in conjunction with other worlds as this will not run as a standalone

2026.11.03.description:
### ADDED
- **Extra Keys** option (`extra_keys_percent`, 0 to 100%, default 20%): hides more key value in the multiworld than you need, so you don't have to find every single key. The helper items like "Bringing in the Explosives! (+10 Vault Keys)" count towards it.
- **Vault Stages** option (`vault_stages`, 1 to 10, default 1): opens The Vault bit by bit. With 4 stages, every 25% of your keys opens a quarter of the Treasures. 1 keeps the old behavior, everything opens at once.
- **Keys Outside The Vault** option (`keys_outside_vault`, on by default): your keys are never hidden in your own Treasures, so the other worlds always hold them.

### CHANGED
- "Keys to open The Vault" is now exactly the amount of keys you need. Before, The Vault always needed 100 keys and you started with the ones you weren't asked to find.
- Generation now stops with a clear message when The Vault is the only game in the multiworld, since its keys have to be hidden in other games.
- If the other games don't have enough room for all your keys, the extra keys are lowered first, then you start with some keys already in hand. The generation log tells you when this happens.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Manual-TheVault/compare/2026.09.12...2026.11.03
2026.11.03.title: 2026.11.03 - Extra Keys & Vault Stages
